title.narrative: Desk Review of Danish Support to UN Women and UNFPA Innovation Facility 2013-2020

description.narrative: The overall objective of the review is to assess the performance of UN Women in using the Danish innovation support over the period 2014 to end of 2020 to strengthen aid effectiveness and improve development results on the ground. The review will focus on the results of UN Women’s innovation activities including their potential for scaling up and alignment with, UN Women’s mandate, key challenges and lessons learned. The review will also consider UN Women’s ability to clearly communicate about its innovation activities and ensure sufficient visibility around the Danish contribution. The review will provide critical input to future recommendations on whether to continue providing Danish funding for UN Women’s Innovation Facility and will provide recommendations on how to address any weaknesses and gaps identified in the review process.
